questions.question: What happened to Jerusalem in chapter 39?
options: It was spared in return for heavy tribute
It was rebuilt grander than ever before
It withstood the siege and the enemy withdrew
It was captured by the Babylonians and burned
questions.answer: It was captured by the Babylonians and burned

questions.question: What happened to King Zedekiah?
options: He was crowned again as a vassal of the Babylonian king
His sons were killed before him, then he was blinded and bound
He fled by night into Egypt and was never seen again
He escaped through a breach in the wall and long lived in hiding
questions.answer: His sons were killed before him, then he was blinded and bound

questions.question: Ebed-melech was promised deliverance because he had put his trust in the LORD.

Nebuchadnezzar gave orders that Jeremiah be looked after and that no _____ come to him.
